Bad Company's "Movin' On" reached #19 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Movin' On" is a song written by Mick Ralphs that was first released as a single by Hackensack in 1972.

The song peaked at #19 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 10 weeks on the chart.

Movin' On was released in 2016.

"Movin' On" is a song written by Mick Ralphs that was first released as a single by Hackensack in 1972.
It was later most famously included on Bad Company's debut album, on which Ralphs played guitar.
"Movin' On" was also released as the second single from the album, as a follow-up to "Can't Get Enough" and reached #19 on the Billboard Hot 100 and #30 in Canada.
